name: saloon-dreem
description: Arabic-first barber salon appointments and business management app

scripts.check:js: node --check frontend/app.js && node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check frontend/runtime-config.js && node --check frontend/sw.js && node --check tools/configure-mobile.mjs && node --check tools/build-web.mjs

scripts.mobile:android:debug: npm run mobile:prepare && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
